title: Preludio
subtitle: The prelude to Act 1 of La traviata, in the Ricordi vocal score

licences.source: Giuseppe Verdi, La traviata (1853), Preludio to Act 1
licences.author: Giuseppe Verdi (1813–1901)

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score (Milan, plate 42314; IMSLP #392068), pages 1–3 (49 bars)
licences.author: Ricordi piano reduction, as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: read by two independent readers and compared with a scan (OMR) reading, every disagreement settled on zoomed images of the page, then checked bar by bar by two fresh proofreaders and corrected. Adagio, 4/4, four sharps; the left hand is in treble clef in bars 1–16. Playback tempo ♩ = 55 (the print gives ♩ = 66), so that the piece lasts as long as the median (3:36) of five complete recordings (Kleiber 1977 3:33, Toscanini 1946 3:36, Muti 1980 3:50, Rahbari 1994 3:56, Mehta 3:01). The tie from the left hand's tremolo half note into the following chord in bars 25–27 is not shown.
